post.description:
Stateless comparison for a full profile - the real engine; used by form mode and tests. Nothing is
stored. An incomplete profile returns 422 'incomplete_profile' with the questions to ask.

The client's profile is not trusted for facts it can't know: today's car is re-read from the Tax
Authority data by its key, and rep confirmations are ignored (only the rep flow can set them).

post.description:
Read a payslip (PDF or image) into profile fields, as printed - for the employee to confirm before
anything is saved. The file is not stored, and the reading has no name, ID number or bank details.
A PDF with text is read from its text and every number is checked against it; an image is read by a
model that reads images. 422 'payslip_unreadable' / 503 'payslip_unavailable' -> fill in by chat.

post.description:
Answer once (atomic): a second answer returns 409 'already_answered'. A participation is an amount
("350"), an occupation is a name from the table - anything else is 422 'invalid_answer'. The answer is
applied to that field of the employee's profile, and the conversation gets the updated comparison.
